bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd "$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
root="$(pwd -P)"
repo=seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot
target=221e3c39dd3096befbef79243875506822f4afb8
stage=deploy/state/area-posting-pr81-221e3c39
localtag=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
previous=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:reliability-e2368044
candidate=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:area-posting-221e3c39
rollback=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:rollback-area-posting-221e3c39
test "$(gh api repos/$repo/pulls/81 --jq '.head.sha')" = "$target"
for run in 46090084997 46090085032 46090084999 46090084994; do
 test "$(gh run view "$run" -R "$repo" --json headSha,status,conclusion --jq '.headSha+" "+.status+" "+.conclusion')" = "$target completed success"
done
test "$(gh api repos/$repo/actions/artifacts/15240064178 --jq '.workflow_run.head_sha')" = "$target"
old_image="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)"
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true
test "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$previous")" = "$old_image"
test "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$localtag")" = "$old_image"
pg_before="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Id}}' deploy-postgres-1)"
ub_before="$(systemctl --user show -p MainPID --value gace-userbot-verify.service)"
test "$ub_before" != 0
python3 -B scripts/userbot_test_client.py health
test ! -e "$stage"
mkdir -m 700 "$stage"
gh run download 46090085032 -R "$repo" -n gaybbs-profile-bundle -D "$stage"
new_sha="$(sha256sum "$stage/gaybbs.mjs" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
printf '%s\n' 'FROM gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local' 'USER root' 'COPY --chown=node:node --chmod=600 gaybbs.mjs /app/gaybbs.mjs' 'USER node' > "$stage/Dockerfile"
docker build --network none --pull=false -q -t "$candidate" -f "$stage/Dockerfile" "$stage"
docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint node "$candidate" --check /app/gaybbs.mjs
test "$(docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint sha256sum "$candidate" /app/gaybbs.mjs | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$new_sha"
new_image="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$candidate")"
docker compose -p deploy -f "$root/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" config -q
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$old_image"
docker tag "$old_image" "$rollback"
swapped=0
accepted=0
cleanup(){
 rc=$?
 trap - EXIT
 if test "$swapped" = 1 && test "$accepted" != 1; then
  docker tag "$rollback" "$localtag"
  docker compose -p deploy -f "$root/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" up -d --no-deps --no-build --force-recreate --timeout 180 gaybbs
  echo GAYBBS_ROLLBACK
 fi
 exit "$rc"
}
trap cleanup EXIT
docker tag "$candidate" "$localtag"
swapped=1
docker compose -p deploy -f "$root/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" up -d --no-deps --no-build --force-recreate --timeout 180 gaybbs
ready=0
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
 if docker logs --tail 300 deploy-gaybbs-1 2>&1 | grep -F 'GAYBBS_POLLING_READY' >/dev/null; then ready=1; break; fi
 sleep 2
done
test "$ready" = 1
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$new_image"
test "$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 sha256sum /app/gaybbs.mjs | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$new_sha"
python3 -B scripts/userbot_test_client.py health
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json,subprocess,sys
chat=-1003847210571
keep={49:{1436},104:{1496,1430}}
remove={621,990,991,992,993,994,995,996,997,998,999}
for tid in sorted(remove|set(keep)):
 p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-B","scripts/userbot_topic_audit_client.py","--chat-id",str(chat),"--topic-id",str(tid)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=100)
 if p.returncode:raise RuntimeError("TOPIC_AUDIT_FAILED")
 data=[json.loads(x.split("=",1)[1]) for x in p.stdout.splitlines() if x.startswith("USERBOT_TOPIC_AUDIT=")]
 if len(data)!=1 or data[0].get("chat")!="area":raise RuntimeError("AUDIT_INVALID")
 rows=[r for r in data[0]["rows"] if r["topic_id"]==tid]
 if len(rows)!=1:raise RuntimeError("TOPIC_ID_MISMATCH")
 r=rows[0]
 found=set(r.get("history_message_ids",[])+r.get("pin_message_ids",[]))
 if tid in keep:
  if r["post_button"]!="PRESENT" or not keep[tid].issubset(found):raise RuntimeError("RETAINED_BUTTON_MISSING")
 else:
  if r["post_button"]!="ABSENT" or r["pin_state"]!="ABSENT_FROM_PINS" or found:raise RuntimeError("BLOCK_BUTTON_REMAINS_OR_UNVERIFIED")
 print(f"AREA_POSTING_READBACK={tid}:{r['post_button']}",flush=True)
print("AREA_POSTING_FINAL_READBACK=PASS",flush=True)
PY
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Id}}' deploy-postgres-1)" = "$pg_before"
test "$(systemctl --user show -p MainPID --value gace-userbot-verify.service)" = "$ub_before"
accepted=1
printf 'GAYBBS_SOURCE=%s\nGAYBBS_BUNDLE_SHA=%s\nGAYBBS_DEPLOY_AND_AREA_POSTING=PASS\n' "$target" "$new_sha"
